summary: __stdcall wrapper that runs a one-time initialization-style registration call with no arguments and then forwards a1 unchanged to a second function, returning that call's result.

operations.description: Invoke OneTimeInitializationWithAtexitStyleRegistration (00404FE0) with no arguments; its side effects are not visible in this function.
